decisions.reason: Hover animation changes gallery-item presentation but does not alter the category tabs or optional other-photography area.
The hover-animation decision applies to gallery items and does not change the homepage hero overlay or image emphasis.
Adding hover animation does not change the independently specified ability to scroll through the interactive gallery.
Gallery-item hover behavior does not modify homepage navigation to detailed pricing information.
The hover-animation request is separate from the diagram, individual-service selection, and pricing-transparency behavior.
Gallery hover animation does not affect the one-time pricing model or visibility of monthly and annual pricing tabs.
The hover-animation decision does not change the four-package count or package-pricing presentation.
The representative-image requirement for each service remains valid unchanged; hover animation targets gallery items rather than service imagery.
Hover animation is a distinct gallery interaction and does not change the existing site-wide image-focused presentation requirement.
The gallery hover-animation decision has no semantic effect on the deferred quote calculator or any of its pricing rules.
